req.title: Cookies domain restriction
req.statement: The system shall not include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host when responding to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should not include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host when responding to /cookies. This ensures that only relevant cookies are returned, adhering to domain restrictions. The test suite will include a positive case to verify correct behavior, a negative case to ensure incorrect domains are excluded, and a boundary case to test edge conditions.

tests.name: test_cookies_domain_restriction_positive
preconditions: The client has a cookie with a matching domain.
actions: Set a cookie with a domain matching the request host.
expected: The response includes the cookie with the matching domain.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

# Set a cookie with a matching domain
client.set_cookie('localhost', 'test_cookie', 'value')

# Send a GET request to /cookies
response = client.get('/cookies')

# Assert the response includes the cookie
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == {'cookies': {'test_cookie': 'value'}}

tests.name: test_cookies_domain_restriction_negative
preconditions: The client has a cookie with a non-matching domain.
actions: Set a cookie with a domain that does not match the request host.
expected: The response does not include the cookie with the non-matching domain.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

# Set a cookie with a non-matching domain
client.set_cookie('example.com', 'test_cookie', 'value')

# Send a GET request to /cookies
response = client.get('/cookies')

# Assert the response does not include the cookie
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == {'cookies': {}}

tests.name: test_cookies_domain_restriction_boundary
preconditions: The client has cookies with domains at the boundary of matching and non-matching.
actions: Set cookies with domains that are at the boundary of matching and non-matching.
expected: The response includes only the cookies with domains that match the request host.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

# Set cookies with boundary domains
client.set_cookie('localhost', 'matching_cookie', 'value1')
client.set_cookie('localhost.local', 'non_matching_cookie', 'value2')

# Send a GET request to /cookies
response = client.get('/cookies')

# Assert the response includes only the matching cookie
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == {'cookies': {'matching_cookie': 'value1'}}
